## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Contract impact

Documented behavior or architectural contract affected: yes/no.
If yes, link the updated OpenSpec requirements/change and user documentation.
If no, explain why the existing contract still applies (including for bug fixes).

## Validation

List checks actually run and any runtime verification still pending.

## Release impact

State the target branch and whether merging can publish or deploy the selected
production branch. Identify any required hotfix backport separately.
